sources.title: What Hardware Runs Voxtral Mini 3B (2507) | AI Audio Model
sources.snippet: Mistral AI Voxtral Mini 3B (2507) Mistral AI's compact 3B-parameter open-weights audio-language model built on Ministral-3B with a Whisper-derived encoder, designed for transcription, audio Q&A, summarization, and function-calling from voice across 8+ languages.

sources.title: textagent/Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507-ONNX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Voxtral Mini 1.0 (3B) - 2507 Voxtral Mini is an enhancement of Ministral 3B, incorporating state-of-the-art audio input capabilities while retaining best-in-class text performance. It excels at speech transcription, translation and audio understanding. This repository contains ONNX weights for the original model, mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507.

sources.title: Voxtral Mini 3B 2507 - Amazon Bedrock
sources.snippet: Voxtral Mini 3B is Mistral AI's compact speech-to-text model for real-time transcription and voice understanding on edge devices. For more information about model development and performance, see the model/service card.

sources.title: Voxtral Mini 3B 2507 - Specs, Capabilities & Benchmarks | Inferbase
sources.snippet: Mistral's Voxtral Mini 3B 2507 is a speech-to-text model that excels at speech transcription, translation, and audio understanding, leveraging its dedicated transcription mode and long-form context window of 131,072 tokens to handle lengthy audios.
